limitations: These are account-wide readings, not exact request or stream costs. Other account activity can inflate deltas; resets, missing/forgotten journal records, failures and cache reuse can remove expenditure. Neither a cold-capture lower bound nor upper bound is established.

Journals were read-only scanned and sorted by captured_at; positive adjacent pointsSpentThisHour differences were summed, negative reset edges omitted; the first request cost and reset-edge request costs are not recovered.
Journal catalog hash is SHA256(json.dumps(sorted([(filename,SHA256(raw_file_bytes)),...]),separators=(comma,colon)).encode()); values include every journal JSON file.

Snapshot stream metadata predates later rendering and can be reused from cache; never add stream metadata deltas to journal sums. Snapshot metadata itself explicitly labels these as account-wide between-readings measurements.

One event page approximately one point is an empirical pattern in these captures, not a verified official tariff. Query shape, report metadata/faction checks/finalization, pagination, owned units, failures, freshness and shared cache all affect cost.
